body.text: Twelve modules on one license. Open the feature list on this page for every name and short note.
The 31-day plan is $35. Lifetime is $150 once. About four 31-day renewals at $35 equal lifetime.

cheats.goodToKnow: Apex Legends and EA Javelin Anticheat update often. Read the status page before you load. GREEN means the note lists this file. RED means wait. Overlay behavior can change after a patch.
cheats.limitations: Third-party software can violate game terms and lead to bans. You use this software at your own risk. Compatibility can change after a game, anti-cheat, or Windows update. Streamproof does not remove that risk.

overview.title: HWID recovery workflow
paragraphs: HWID Spoofer is a separate key for a hardware flag. It rotates disk, MAC, and GPU identifiers on a PC you own. It is not included with the menu.
$50 for 31 days or $150 lifetime. It does not fix an account-only restriction on the same machine.

body.text: Use when fresh accounts fail on one PC but work elsewhere—not for account-only bans. Pair with conservative cheat presets after verification.

spoofer.goodToKnow: HWID tools change how your PC fingerprint appears. They do not clear an account-only penalty. Read the portal notes before you launch Apex Legends again.
spoofer.limitations: Spoofing carries technical risk and may violate game terms. Results vary by ban type and driver setup. Use only on systems you own.
